name: What is included in a typical website optimization package for a pediatric clinic?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a typical website optimization package for a pediatric clinic?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical website optimization package for a pediatric clinic often includes several core services. This usually encompasses technical SEO audits to fix site errors, on-page SEO for optimizing content with relevant keywords, local SEO strategies to attract nearby patients, and mobile optimization to ensure the site performs well on all devices. Additionally, it may involve content strategy recommendations, user experience (UX) improvements, and regular performance reporting to track progress and adjust strategies.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical package includes technical and on-page SEO, local SEO, mobile optimization, content strategy, UX improvements, and performance reporting.
